p1.title: TurVia — Smart Tourism & Navigation
p1.description: A comprehensive tourism app featuring smart routing, real-time recommendations, personalized trip planning, and a tour management system with secure in-app payments (iyzico/Stripe) and real-time operational workflows.

p2.title: KURTAR — IoT & AI-Based Disaster Response App
p2.description: Developed the Flutter app end-to-end, integrating Google Maps for real-time incident visualization, and built an offline-first BLE layer featuring E2EE 1-to-1 and group messaging, RSSI/magnetometer localization, role-based access, and pre-incident health profiles to expedite rescue operations. Co-trained lightweight models (CNN, LSTM, GNN) with PyTorch on time-series IoT and mobile sensor data, then converted and deployed them via TensorFlow Lite for on-device real-time disaster decision support.

p3.title: Kurtar Saha — Field Data & AI Suite
p3.description: An integrated ecosystem of two Flutter apps for seismic research: a field data acquisition tool with high-frequency sensor logging and precision Hz sampling, plus an AI inference app for real-time model validation via WebSocket.

p4.title: DigiVis — Digital Onboarding & KYC
p4.description: A secure digital onboarding SDK for iOS & Android with high-fidelity camera capture, Liveness Detection, Face Matching algorithms, NFC/MRZ document reading, and a centralized dashboard for real-time administrative oversight.

p5.title: IbanVault — Secure IBAN Manager
p5.description: Offline-first Flutter app for encrypted IBAN storage with QR code generation & scanning, multi-language support (EN/TR/AR), RTL-aware layouts, and AES-encrypted local database. Clean MVC architecture with Provider.

p6.title: Vakit — Smart Prayer Times App
p6.description: A multilingual Islamic prayer times app with GPS-based & manual city selection, 3 saved cities, timely local notifications, customizable reminders, and RTL-aware UI available in Turkish, English, and Arabic.

p7.title: LenDeX — Smart Lending UI
p7.description: A high-fidelity Flutter UI kit for personal budgeting and micro-lending app designs. Featuring pixel-perfect layouts, responsive dashboard components, interactive charts, and smooth animation transitions.

p8.title: AI Financial — Visually Impaired (Thesis)
p8.description: Undergraduate graduation thesis awarded with Honours. A YOLOv5-powered mobile app providing real-time money recognition and full financial management for visually impaired users, backed by Firebase and intelligent accessibility design.

p9.title: NetGuard — LAN Security Analyzer
p9.description: A Flutter app for non-intrusive LAN network analysis and connected device discovery. Uses an Evidence Scoring engine that combines open ports, response time, and MAC address data to classify devices by risk level. Built with Clean Architecture, MVVM (Provider), and Dart Isolates for parallel scanning without blocking the UI.

syncledger.title: SyncLedger
syncledger.description: A Flutter app for small businesses to manage billing, products, shop settings, and Bluetooth thermal printing in a streamlined ledger workflow.

pharma.title: Pharma
pharma.description: A full-featured pharmacy management system built with Flutter and Firebase. Features role-based authentication (Admin/Manager/Cashier), real-time dashboard KPIs, medicine CRUD with barcode & voice search, batch/FIFO inventory tracking, purchase orders, POS with cart/tax/discount, PDF invoice generation, daily/weekly/monthly profit reports with charts, customer & supplier management, push notifications for expiry and low stock, Excel/PDF export, AI medicine recommendations, dark mode, multi-store support, and Firebase backup & restore.

web1.title: Kurtar Command Dashboard
web1.description: Live command center for the KURTAR mobile app with role-based access: real-time earthquake/incident mapping, shortest-safe-path routing for rescue teams, field-responder tracking, and resource, incident, and alert management.

web2.title: DigiVis Enterprise Dashboard
web2.description: Multi-tenant admin panel giving each partner company its own scoped, role-based access to manage users and track its KYC pipeline — request status, approval history, and audit logs for compliance.

web3.title: Malahi Vending Machine Fleet Dashboard
web3.description: Role-based fleet monitoring across 150+ vending machines: real-time machine/payment telemetry, automated low-stock and maintenance alerts, and per-machine sales/inventory analytics.

web4.title: TurVia Partner Dashboard
web4.description: Role-based, operator-facing web console for the TurVia tour management system: booking and itinerary management, in-app payment reconciliation, and real-time operational workflow tracking.

web5.title: Invoice Management App
web5.description: Debt collection and invoicing platform for managing customer accounts, tracking outstanding balances, and generating invoices.
